payload.body_you: You leave a conversation with {{holder1}} convinced they said one thing. {{holder1}} thinks they said something completely different. Both of you can be arguing from a version of the conversation the other person does not recognize.
payload.body_they: {{holder1}} hears a meaning you did not intend and answers that instead. You think you were clear. {{holder1}} thinks the point was obvious too. The disagreement grows because both of you are responding to different sentences.
